amendment_v3.diagnosis: structural throttle in CausalSemigroupPropagator.forward_anchored: correction decode(h_k) never sees base_k (anchor enters only the next-step recurrence) and the decoder is 1x1-conv only (zero spatial receptive field), so the per-frame correction cannot express displacement/reshaping of the current render
amendment_v3.fix: FrameConditionedPropagator subclass: decode input = step_norm(h_k+cond_latent+base_latent_k) (same driven state as the recurrence, so the correction is conditioned on the current anchor frame) + 3x3-conv decoder with GELU; final conv zero-init preserves the exact no-op warm start (CPU-verified: bit-exact base reproduction, gradient reach, causal prefix invariance)
amendment_v3.judgement_unchanged: gates A/B, budget (60 ep), metric, manifest, and seeds are identical to the frozen v1 judgement; v2 lanes write to *_v2_* directories
amendment_v3.single_variable_caveat: the fix bundles decode-input conditioning + receptive field; attribution between them is NOT claimed
amendment_v3.v1_outcome: all 4 lanes interrupted at ep23 by the user: train_loss==eval==baseline (~0.1258-0.1262) plateau from ep10, max frozen at 0.5046 -- UNDERFIT (train loss could not descend), not an optimizer or budget issue; v1 lanes preserved in results/b2_snapshot_ic_ic*_20260830/

bindings.trainer_script: scripts/train_b2_snapshot_ic.py (to be written; its sha256 recorded in an infra-only amendment before launch)

budget.abort_rule: abort a lane if epoch-1 wall time projects > 6 h for that lane, or on NaN loss
budget.artifact_policy: per lane: best.pt + metrics.jsonl + terminal.json; rendered base_seq cache ~90x64x201x201 fp16 ~ 465 MB shared once
budget.estimate_basis: smoke: 15 records/step-batch at 4.2 s/step; 90 records => 30 micro-steps/epoch x 60 epochs x ~6s projected(width 64 ~2x width 32 cost) / parallel lanes

data_access.truth_policy: true wavefield frames are train-only supervision EXCEPT the first 8 frames of each window, which the deployment contract designates as inference-time inputs

design.anchor: warp_r1/run/best.pt rendered per record over the manifest window (frames [window_start, window_start+64)), rendered once and cached to disk before training
design.gate_fix: gate_init=1.0 with gate frozen (requires_grad=False) + zero-init decoder output conv; smoke-validated; note this bundles two sub-factors that were NOT separately attributed - any deeper claim about the mechanism needs its own ablation
design.grid: 2 arms (ic2, ic8) x 2 seeds (372, 733), one lane per GPU, 4 GPUs total
design.ic_rule: initial_state = LAST ic_frames of the 8 visible true frames; both arms see the same 8 visible frames; loss/metric only on frames >= 8
design.model: CausalSemigroupPropagator width=64, spectral_rank=32, modes=24, depth=4 (module defaults), state_channels = 2 or 8 per arm, cond_channels=7 (r25 static_features recipe)
design.parallelism_note: per-lane single-GPU; v3 smoke measured that widening batch does NOT speed up the 64-frame serial rollout (4.96 s/step at bs15 vs 4.2 s/step at bs3), so throughput is taken as 4 independent lanes
design.records: the frozen 90-record manifest, identical for every lane
design.training: AdamW lr 1e-3 cosine to 1e-5, weight_decay 1e-6, grad clip 1.0, micro_records 3, 60 epochs over 90 records (1800 steps), eval every epoch on all 90

evidence_boundary: success on this development subset authorizes nothing beyond continuing the line; validation full-split and test_id stay sealed

judgement_frozen.baseline: warp_r1 anchor aggregate on the same window/records, computed once at lane start (was 0.13149 on the 15-record smoke; the 90-record value is measured, not assumed)
judgement_frozen.failure_signal: no arm passes gate A: the anchored-B2 correction lever is noise-level at this capacity/budget on this subset; next lever is capacity/rollout-structure, not IC frames
judgement_frozen.gate_A_beats_anchor: an arm counts as beating the anchor iff BOTH its seeds' best scores are below baseline - 0.002
judgement_frozen.gate_B_ic_difference: ic8 counts as different from ic2 iff |mean(ic8) - mean(ic2)| > max(arm noise bands) AND the sign is consistent across both seed pairings
judgement_frozen.no_post_hoc_extension: 60 epochs per lane; no budget extension without a new preregistration
judgement_frozen.noise_band: per arm: |seed372_best - seed733_best|; the arm-level score is the mean of the two seeds
judgement_frozen.primary_metric: eval-window aggregate relative L2 (frames 8..63, per-record joint, float64, mean over 90 records), best over epochs per lane

motivation: User-mandated deployment contract: high-fidelity solver output is train-only supervision; at prediction time the model receives ONLY the first N true wavefield snapshots plus solve-free inputs. The anchored CausalSemigroupPropagator (B2) over the frozen warp_r1 render satisfies this contract (straight-ray travel time is closed-form, no PDE solve at inference). The 4-lane smoke (results/smoke_b2_v4_*.json) validated the pipeline: zero-conv warm-start fixes the documented gate-collapse mode, all lanes beat the anchor (-0.0028 to -0.0038 vs base 0.13149), and IC frames 2-vs-8 were indistinguishable at 200 steps (arm gap 0.0001 < seed gap 0.0004-0.0009), leaving the IC-capacity question to this longer run.
question: With epoch-scale training on the frozen 90-record subset, does an 8-frame true-snapshot IC beat a 2-frame IC by more than the seed-to-seed noise band, and does either arm deliver a real improvement over the frozen warp_r1 anchor?
rollback: additive line; no prior checkpoint (R54/R56/warp_r1) is modified
smoke_overlap_disclosure: 3 of the 90 manifest records (validation_layered_00092, validation_marmousi_00127, validation_uniform_00074) also appeared in the 15-record smoke used to de-risk this pipeline. The smoke trained tiny width-32 models for 200 steps that are NOT warm-started into this run, so no weight leakage; disclosed for completeness.
